# Documents

This folder contains the raw extracted text chunks from the 2023 and 2024 annual reports of the Danish Quality Database for Inflammatory Bowel Disease (DANIBD). The pages preserve the original PDF pagination and structure, covering national and regional quality indicator results, patient demographics, surgical and medical treatment monitoring, and official audit responses from the five Danish healthcare regions. These documents serve as the foundational source material for all entities, topics, and claims mapped elsewhere in the wiki.

## Pages

- [[danibd-2023-part-001]] — Title page, conclusions, and demographic characteristics for pediatric IBD patients from the 2023 annual report.
- [[danibd-2023-part-002]] — Demographic characteristics for adult IBD patients and the national overview of quality indicators from the 2023 report.
- [[danibd-2023-part-003]] — Detailed results for BMSL monitoring, post-operative Crohn's follow-up, and 30-day re-operation rates from the 2023 report.
- [[danibd-2023-part-004]] — PSC colonoscopy follow-up results, disease background, and the data foundation methodology from the 2023 report.
- [[danibd-2023-part-005]] — Steering committee membership and supplementary appendix tables covering regional patient characteristics and BMSL treatments from the 2023 report.
- [[danibd-2023-part-006]] — Appendix tables detailing surgical procedures and PSC demographics, plus regional comments from the 2023 report.
- [[danibd-2024-part-001]] — Title page, table of contents, and the steering committee's conclusions and recommendations from the 2024 annual report.
- [[danibd-2024-part-002]] — Patient demographics for children and adults, alongside the national overview of all seven quality indicators from the 2024 report.
- [[danibd-2024-part-003]] — Results and discussions for Indicators 1a and 1b, covering diagnostic endoscopy and MRI workups for newly diagnosed adults and children.
- [[danibd-2024-part-004]] — Results for Indicator 2 (patient education) and Indicator 3 (post-operative colonoscopy for Crohn's disease) from the 2024 report.
- [[danibd-2024-part-005]] — Detailed data on Indicator 4 (DEXA scanning for steroid users) and Indicator 5 (calprotectin monitoring for BMSL patients) from the 2024 report.
- [[danibd-2024-part-006]] — Indicator 6 results on 30-day surgical re-operation rates, including procedure codes and funnel plots from the 2024 report.
- [[danibd-2024-part-007]] — Indicator 7 results on PSC surveillance colonoscopies, followed by the clinical description of IBD and the data foundation from the 2024 report.
- [[danibd-2024-part-008]] — Registry methodology, database coverage validation, steering committee members, and appendix tables on regional demographics and education from the 2024 report.
- [[danibd-2024-part-009]] — Supplementary appendix tables detailing BMSL patient characteristics, specific biologic treatments, and surgical procedure frequencies from the 2024 report.
- [[danibd-2024-part-010]] — Official regional comments and audit responses from all five Danish healthcare regions regarding the 2024 indicator results.
